items.headline: Climate committee gets early look at 2025 emissions data
items.summary: The Climate Action and Sustainability Committee reviewed a preliminary 2025 greenhouse gas inventory, including an overview of indirect (Scope 3) emissions, and discussed approaches the city could take toward its carbon neutrality goal.

items.headline: 272-unit apartment building permitted on West San Carlos
items.summary: A 272-unit apartment building at 860 W San Carlos St has received its building permit, with a construction valuation of about $80.8 million. It's one of the largest multi-family projects cleared to build in this batch of permits.

items.headline: Seven detached ADU buildings permitted at one 2nd St address
items.summary: Seven separate two-story detached ADU buildings (units 9-15) have been permitted at 584 N 2nd St, each valued near $569,000. The pattern of multiple standalone ADU structures on a single lot is an unusual way to add housing density compared to a typical single-ADU permit.

items.headline: Utilities panel reviews reserve policy overhaul
items.summary: The Utilities Advisory Commission discussed a Baker Tilly report on the city's utility reserves and considered recommending updated Reserve Management Policies to the City Council, which could affect how much cash the city keeps on hand for its electric, water, and gas funds.

items.headline: Committee weighs allowing housing in ROLM office zone
items.summary: Palo Alto's Economic Development Committee is considering a recommendation to the City Council to amend the zoning code so multi-family residential uses could be conditionally permitted in the ROLM(E) office/research/manufacturing district.

items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: The Santa Clara City Council was scheduled to hear an appeal of a permit approval for a project at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street, which would demolish existing buildings and build 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space.
